outline: Students will learn about optical design principles and specifics of various applications. The class will first give an overview of basic elements of optical systems and examine their working principles. Later systems are examined. Through exercises, students will be enabled to design advanced optical systems for experiments. The class is taught in English and all student assignments will be required to be in English.
schedule:
1. Course overview, basic optical design workflow
2. Refractive optical elements
3. Refractive optical systems /
Exercise + Assignment 1
4. Filters
5. Deflective optical Elements
6. Non-linear optical elements
7. Light sources
8. Sensors
9. Interferometers /
Exercise + Assignment 2
10. fast Optics
11. Active optical elements
12. Active optical elements 2
13. Common Microscopes /
Exercise + Assignment 3
14. Advanced Microscopes
15. Advanced Systems 2
16. Final Exam

category: 學生分組實作及討論(Student group practice and discussion)
